title: Small wind turbine for a wind-tunnel competition
statement: Design a small wind turbine that produces as much electricity as possible in a wind tunnel, survives strong gusts, and shuts itself down safely on command or when its electrical load is disconnected.
constraints: Every part of the turbine (rotor and body) fits inside a 45 cm cube; only the mounting post below it may be outside
Survives continuous wind of 22 m/s without damage
Produces power between 5 and 11 m/s wind
When the load is disconnected or on command, the rotor slows to below 10% of its top speed within 10 seconds and stays there
